news.title: GCA Launcher 3.0 Preview Tour
news.summary: Explore a modernized single screen launcher by GocalSD.
news.content: We are thrilled to announce GCA Launcher 3.0 Open Beta! I will officially launch GCA v3 in 2027 with a subscription model to pro features. If you havn't been keeping an eye on my social feed, get caught up on whats new in GCA with this tour I provided on Youtube.

news.title: GCA v3 Test Video
news.summary: View a test session of GCA v3
news.content: This was one of my first visual test videos coming out to the public for GCA v3. We show off some of the homescreen interactions and Groups 2.0

news.title: Incoming Update
news.summary: Another beta update is headed your way
news.content: The upcoming update shouldnt carrie any weight with it and hopefully no bugs but this update is all about cleanup, as its been a very busy week. You may notice some new settings in the maintenance section and a slight clean up but whats more interesting is the new dashboard settings ive included in the Recents Apps Analytics. Users can now track intent activity to ensure GCA Launcher is launching apps correctly and securely. If you notice any funny business or say a bank app not luanching properly. Trigger the intent watcher logs and see if anything red pops up. If it does, relay that information to me so we can solve the issue together. This new dashboard is all yours to control and see. Any information that leaks out is truely up to you to share it but that data stays with you.
